column12: Probably from Nahuatl coatl (twin). Standard: amigo.
Constant among young friends; rude to anyone else. Also written wey.
Chava: young woman. Standard: joven, muchacho.
As a noun, padre is father.
The polite cousin of a cruder phrase.
Also: hurry up! Ándale pues: OK then.
Standard: dinero. Lana is also wool.
Vulgar. Understand it; do not use it.
